title: How teams exchange work
hook: A toy delivery repeatedly pays a coordination cost. What changes with a service interface?

knows: basic arithmetic and the meaning of a percentage
doesNotKnow: Account for recurring interaction cost when comparing a collaborative handoff with a stipulated service interface.

misconception: A stable interface changes labels but cannot change the recurring coordination budget.
objective: Account for recurring interaction cost when comparing a collaborative handoff with a stipulated service interface.

claims.text: The named work is Team Topologies, by Matthew Skelton and Manuel Pais, candidate publication year 2019.
claims.source: Matthew Skelton and Manuel Pais, Team Topologies (2019); chapter (unconfirmed); edition and bibliography not independently opened. Access hold F1.

claims.text: Team Topologies distinguishes interaction modes between teams, including collaboration and consuming another team’s service.
claims.source: Matthew Skelton and Manuel Pais, Team Topologies (2019); chapter (unconfirmed); edition and bibliography not independently opened. Access hold F1.

claims.text: Original stipulated intervals model: A inputs [60, 10, 10] yield 30; B inputs [60, 10, 2] yield 50. Prediction correct option 50. A completes {A} work minutes; B completes {B}. Each ten-minute delivery still happens, but the stipulated interaction cost falls from ten to two. Interface costs are invented; this does not simulate cognitive load or the book’s organizational outcomes.
claims.source: Original lesson construction; EDD-010 formula ; exact independent Python arithmetic recomputation recorded in answerCheck; no book dataset or measured human response.

claims.text: A toy interface needs 8 work and 2 coordination minutes per delivery, within 50 minutes. Finished work minutes? Five complete ten-minute deliveries fit; their work portions total 40 minutes.
claims.source: Original transfer toy, intervals, inputs [50, 8, 2], output 40; independent Python recomputation.

claims.text: Does it hold up? Real-world applicability and the connection to the book remain unverified.
claims.source: Scope limitation, not a research verdict: only original toy derivation supplied. Publication requires independently opened book chapter and separate real-world evidence review; no effectiveness inference is made.

recall.why: Five complete ten-minute deliveries fit; their work portions total 40 minutes.
